data.name: SILVER FALLS
data.detailed_description:
Silver Falls is a first-person psychological horror game with a VHS aesthetic, telling the story of a complex and unsettling investigation.

Take on the role of a detective arriving at the Silver Falls resort. Local authorities have requested your assistance following a macabre discovery. Now, together with your partner, you must examine the motel grounds and forest campsites. Late summer in Alaska brings cold nights and an eerie silence where ordinary clues lead to terrifying conclusions. You will soon realize that in Silver Falls, reality is much more fragile than it seems.

Gameplay

The game is a first-person walking simulator with a focus on exploration and finding leads. You will navigate the dark woods, solve environmental problems, and use logic to progress. Attentiveness and intuition are your primary tools in this investigation.

Key Features

  • Nighttime Alaskan Atmosphere: An oppressive environment of a desolate resort where the unknown lurks around every corner.

  • VHS Realism Aesthetic: A visual style inspired by the era of analog video and found footage.

  • Detective Work: Explore locations, gather evidence, and piece together the sequence of events.

  • Environmental Interaction: Examine items in 3D, read left-behind notes, and study found materials.

  • Logical Tasks: Use found objects to gain access to restricted areas and move forward in your investigation.

  • Psychological Tension: A horror experience built on the dread of the unknown and the realization that nothing is as it seems.

data.short_description: Arrive in Alaska to solve a case involving a macabre discovery. Interview witnesses, gather clues in the night woods, and uncover the dark secret of Silver Falls. Try to maintain your sanity in this chilling psychological VHS horror.
